title: Applied Practice in Indigenous Contexts
description: Examines systems of working in meaningful and reciprocal relationships with Indigenous communities. It explores Indigenous epistemologies - ways of knowing, doing, being. Emphasis on the development of positive and effective practice frameworks and practical strategies that support healing, wellness, resilience in Indigenous contexts are central.
notes: Students in the Bachelor of Child and Youth Care program must earn a minimum grade of C+ in all pre- or co-requisites.
